articles.title: Tokenized securities need competition, not gatekeepers
articles.snippet: Innovation thrives when investors have choices. For tokenized securities, Washington shouldn't pick winners before the market has a chance to learn what works, argues Patrick McHenry, vice chairman at Ondo Finance and former Chairman of the House Financial Services Committee.

articles.title: UK to lower stablecoin capital buffers, undercutting EU's MiCA requirements
articles.snippet: The Financial Conduct Authority's proposal follows the Bank of England's backtracking on the limit to the value of stablecoins an individual could hold.

articles.title: Ether, solana and dogecoin slide as Strategy's bitcoin sales plan pressures market
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held below $60,000 as a surging dollar kept crypto pinned. Onchain demand stayed quiet through the week's losses, and Strategy's plan to possibly sell bitcoin added to the caution.

articles.title: Bitcoin price risks drop below $58K as US dollar hits 40-year high against yen
articles.snippet: Bitcoin faced downside pressure as the US dollar hit its highest levels against the Japanese yen since 1986, while BTC price analysis revealed "capitulation" by 2025 top-buyers.

articles.title: AI’s power crunch turns Bitcoin miners’ grid access into an asset
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miners have the power sites AI companies need, but turning old mining campuses into real data center revenue is no easy pivot.
